title: Use the Robot Selection Overview panel to identify the selected robot, its location, and tote status
summary: Use the Robot Selection Overview HMI panel to identify the selected robot’s robot ID and location, and determine whether the robot is carrying a tote, has a tote mismatch (tote “?”), or has no tote (shows “layer_1”).
when_to_use: When you need to quickly identify which robot is causing an issue and confirm its robot ID, location, and tote status from the Robot Selection Overview panel after selecting a robot.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the panel checks to capture robot ID, location, and tote status indicators for troubleshooting.
access_or_tools_needed: Tote/robot selection HMI screen: Robot Selection Overview (Robot x Robot panel)
Mouse/pointing device to click a robot and the small arrow to expand the detail section

system_preconditions: Robot Selection Overview view is available and the Robot x Robot panel is visible.

visual_references.description: Robot Selection Overview panel showing: selected robot box, expandable detail section (small arrow), robot ID/location fields, tote ID indicator (including tote “?” meaning), and “layer_1” when no tote is present.

steps.title: Open the Robot Selection Overview view (Robot x Robot panel)
steps.purpose: Get to the panel where you can select a robot and view its robot-specific details.
steps.instruction: Open the Robot Selection Overview view where the “Robot x Robot” panel and the robot-selection behavior are shown.
steps.expected_result: The Robot Selection Overview panel is visible and you can click a robot in the robot list/grid.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the robot selection area (Robot x Robot panel) and the UI supports selecting a robot.
steps.failure_condition: The Robot Selection Overview panel is not accessible/visible, or you cannot select robots on the panel.

actions.label: Open Robot Selection Overview
actions.exact_action: Open the Robot Selection Overview view where the “Robot x Robot” panel is shown.

steps.title: Select a robot and confirm it is highlighted with a box
steps.purpose: Ensure the panel is showing details for the intended robot.
steps.instruction: Click the robot you want to investigate on the Robot Selection Overview panel and confirm the selected robot has a box around it.
steps.expected_result: The selected robot is highlighted with a box around it, indicating the panel has switched to that robot’s details.
steps.healthy_condition: A box appears around the robot you clicked (selected robot state).
steps.failure_condition: No box appears around the robot you clicked, or the highlighted selection does not match the robot you intended to select.
stop_or_escalate_if: If the selected robot highlight/box does not appear or does not match the intended robot, stop and escalate to support.

steps.title: Expand the robot detail section if it is hidden
steps.purpose: Reveal the robot detail fields (robot ID, location, and tote indicators) needed for diagnosis.
steps.instruction: If the robot detail section is hidden, click the small arrow control to expand it so all robot detail information is visible.
steps.expected_result: The robot detail section expands and shows the available robot detail information.
steps.healthy_condition: The small arrow expands the detail area and the robot detail fields become visible.
steps.failure_condition: The detail section cannot be expanded (small arrow not available or does nothing).

actions.label: Expand details
actions.exact_action: click on the small arrow and it will show up… expand to all the details

stop_or_escalate_if: If the detail section cannot be expanded (small arrow not available/does nothing), stop and escalate to support.

steps.title: Record the robot ID and location from the expanded details
steps.purpose: Identify the exact robot and its location to correlate with the reported issue.
steps.instruction: In the expanded details, record the robot ID and location fields shown for the selected robot.
steps.expected_result: You have captured the selected robot’s robot ID and location from the detail panel.
steps.healthy_condition: Robot ID and location fields are visible and populated for the selected robot.
steps.failure_condition: Robot ID and/or location fields are not visible or not populated for the selected robot.

actions.label: Read robot ID and location
actions.exact_action: look at the robot ID and location

stop_or_escalate_if: If robot ID/location indicators are not visible, stop and escalate to support.

steps.title: Check tote area under the robot ID and note tote ID (or tote mismatch indicator)
steps.purpose: Determine whether the robot is carrying a tote and whether the tote state indicates a mismatch after robot removal.
steps.instruction: Under the robot ID, check the tote indicator. If a tote ID is shown (example shown: tote #96), note the tote ID.
steps.expected_result: The tote indicator under the robot ID is identified and you have noted the tote ID when present.
steps.healthy_condition: A tote ID is displayed under the robot ID (tote present).
steps.failure_condition: The tote indicator under the robot ID is missing/unclear, or does not match the expected panel behavior for tote presence.

actions.label: Read tote ID under robot ID
actions.exact_action: see that you have the robot ID as well as something called the 9696… This indicates that this robot has a tote, and this is the tote's ID

stop_or_escalate_if: If the robot ID/location/tote indicators are not visible or do not match the expected panel behavior described in the source, stop and escalate to support.

steps.title: Interpret tote indicator with a “?” before it as robot removed but tote not removed
steps.purpose: Detect a tote mismatch state that commonly occurs after robot removal.
steps.instruction: If the tote text shows a “?” before it, interpret it as: the robot was removed but the tote has not.
steps.expected_result: You correctly classify the tote state as a mismatch using the “?” indicator.
steps.healthy_condition: The tote indicator under the robot ID includes a “?” before the tote value.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot determine whether the tote indicator includes a “?” or the indicator does not behave as described.

actions.label: Check for “?” prefix
actions.exact_action: If the tote has a "?" before it, that means the robot has been removed but the tote has not.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the tote indicator does not match the expected “?” behavior, stop and escalate to support.

steps.title: Confirm no-tote state shows “layer_1” and no brown-box tote visual
steps.purpose: Confirm the robot is not carrying a tote.
steps.instruction: If the robot does not have a tote, confirm the display shows “layer_1” and that the brown-box tote visual is not shown.
steps.expected_result: You confirm the robot is in the no-tote state by observing “layer_1” and absence of the brown-box tote visual.
steps.healthy_condition: The tote section indicates “layer_1” and there is no brown-box tote visual on the robot/tote section.
steps.failure_condition: “layer_1” is not shown when no tote is present, or the brown-box tote visual appears despite no tote being indicated.

actions.label: Verify layer_1 and no brown-box tote
actions.exact_action: If a robot doesn't have a tote it will say layer_1… If the robot doesn't is not carrying any tote, you will not see this brown box at all on the tote section.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the tote/no-tote indicators do not match the expected panel behavior, stop and escalate to support.

success_criteria: Robot ID and location are recorded for the selected robot from the Robot Selection Overview detail panel.
Tote status is classified as one of: tote ID shown (tote present), tote “?” prefix (robot removed but tote not removed), or “layer_1” with no brown-box tote visual (no tote).
healthy_conditions: Selected robot shows a box around it.
Detail section can be expanded using the small arrow when hidden.
Robot ID and location fields are visible after expansion.
Tote indicator behavior matches one of the three described states (tote ID, “?” prefix, or “layer_1” with no brown-box tote visual).
failure_conditions: Detail section cannot be expanded (small arrow not available/does nothing).
Robot ID/location/tote indicators are not visible or do not match the expected panel behavior.
Tote indicator state cannot be determined (e.g., unclear “?” prefix or unclear “layer_1”/brown-box visual).
escalation_guidance: If the detail section cannot be expanded or if robot ID/location/tote indicators are not visible or do not match expected behavior, stop and escalate to support.

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Robot Selection Overview panel: selected robot box, small arrow for expanding hidden detail section, robot ID and location fields, tote ID under robot ID, tote “?” prefix meaning mismatch, and “layer_1” with no brown-box tote visual when no tote is present.
